details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:73-99 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The three quoted `PY` heredoc terminators are indented, so Bash will not recognize them and the workflow step will fail to parse.
  WHY: Quoted heredocs require the terminator at column 0, and all four reviewers identified the same parse-time failure across the three `python3 - <<'PY'` blocks.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:167-176 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `bootstrap_validation_manifest()` can raise `shutil.Error`, but the caller only catches `OSError` and `FileNotFoundError`.
  WHY: A copy failure would escape the handler and abort the refresh run; reviewers ranged from low to high severity, so the highest reported severity is high.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:881-885 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `JUDGE_REPEAT_FINGERPRINT_MAX` rejects `0`, so operators cannot disable the breaker with the same convention used by similar settings.
  WHY: The `-lt 1` check blocks an explicit zero-disable value.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2237-2264 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `normalize_judge_justification_for_fingerprint()` shells out to `python3` directly, so missing Python 3 leaves the normalization step without a fallback.
  WHY: If `python3` is unavailable, fingerprint normalization can fail and weaken repeat-failure detection; one reviewer disputed this based on surrounding shell fallbacks.
- scripts/apply_audit_gate_assets.py:25-29 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_safe_relative_path()` only rejects absolute paths and `..`, so symlink or other normalization-based traversal can still escape the intended path.
  WHY: The helper does not resolve the path before validation, leaving a traversal gap.
- tests/test_validation_refresh_runner.py:~435+ | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The bootstrap test checks file existence and text content, but it does not validate that the generated manifest is valid YAML.
  WHY: A malformed fixture could still pass this test and fail later at YAML parsing time; moonshot and z-ai treated this as a test-hardening concern rather than a bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
